boardTitle: B168: the recipe's PD card counts what Cook it is set to
title: The numbers under One portion show the whole recipe

opportunity.from: Seen while drawing B166, 23 November 2026, on Lazy Burek's page; Coach Milan 24 November 07:04: yes, its own ticket, we need to fix that.
opportunity.job: Read what one portion of my recipe holds.
opportunity.kind: Says something not true: the table under One portion shows the whole recipe.
opportunity.why_now: B166 made the table readable, so its numbers are now read.

problem: On a recipe that makes 4 portions, the PD card says One portion, 549 kcal and 224 g. Its numbers say Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal, fat 135 g: the whole recipe. The Nutrition table below says 1 portion, 224 g. Two places on one page disagree about one portion.
story: When I read the numbers of a recipe, I want them to count the portions I choose, one or the whole recipe, so that I can trust what I plan, eat and cook.
now: The card says One portion, 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g. Its numbers are handed the whole recipe: Total 897 g, 2,194 kcal. Cook it's − 4 portions + below the card changes only the foods to cook.
proposed: Variant (Coach Milan 07:58): no new buttons in the card. The card counts what Cook it is set to, with the − and + the page already has. At 4 portions, as the recipe makes it: All 4 portions, 2,194 kcal · 93.4 g protein · 897 g, and the numbers the whole recipe. At 1: One portion, 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g, and the numbers one portion. PD and the letters stay, they are rates. While the recipe is edited, and on a page with no Cook it, the card counts one portion. A recipe of one portion says All of it, as now.
looked_at: A: − and + in the card's title (drawn 07:55): not chosen, Coach Milan 07:58: no more navigation in the card, use the − and + we have. The card always one portion (drawn 07:10): not chosen; the whole recipe's numbers would be lost. The Plate's PD card layout for the recipe page, one component, a design rule: its own ticket, DT349 (Coach Milan 07:58).
short: The recipe's PD card and its numbers count what Cook it is set to; release 0.3.193

ac.title: The card follows Cook it
ac.text: Given Lazy Burek with Cook it at 4 portions, as the recipe makes it, when I open its page, then the card says All 4 portions and 2,194 kcal · 93.4 g protein · 897 g

ac.title: Down to one portion
ac.text: Given that page, when I tap Cook it's − three times, then the card says One portion and 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g

ac.title: The numbers follow
ac.text: Given Cook it at 1, when I tap the letters, then the numbers say Total 224 g and 549 kcal; at 4 portions they say Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal

ac.title: Rates stay
ac.text: Given Cook it at 1 or at 4, when I read PD and the letters, then they say 4.3 and F+ c- fi- p

ac.title: More than the recipe makes
ac.text: Given Cook it at 6 portions, when I read the card, then it says 6 portions and 3,291 kcal

ac.title: Editing counts one portion
ac.text: Given Edit recipe open, when I read the card, then it says One portion, as the card follows the foods while I type

ac.title: A recipe of one portion
ac.text: Given a recipe that makes 1 portion, when I open its page, then the card says All of it, as now

unchanged: Cook it's − and +: the foods to cook follow, as now; its choice stays with the recipe, as now.
The letters, F+ c- fi- p: per 100 kcal.
The Nutrition table: 1 portion, All 4 and 100 g, as now.
The card's layout, as now (its new layout is DT349).
The colours of the table, as B166.
checks: Middle: a behaviour on the recipe page (Recipes), new words. The unit tests, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC7, and the walkthroughs of the recipe page's card and of Cook it: chip-lines, fibre, recipe-centre, recipe-nutrition, recipe-import, recipe-photos, dish-first, oil-taken-up, two-breakfasts, batch-cook, recipe-mark, your-cooks, and the German sweep. About 15 minutes.
details: NutritionCard takes count: Cook it's number on the recipe page (meal.cook.n, or what the recipe makes); none while editing or on an imported recipe's page, which counts one portion. The rows and the numbers take the foods at their grams times count divided by the portions.
New words: nutrition.nPortions (2 portions), nutrition.allPortions (All 4 portions); Srpski confirmed by Claude, German in Beta.
Seen while drawing, not in B168: Cook it at 1 says 1 portions.
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.192; new from one scratch build of main where the card follows Cook it, not committed.
